I am an old man, 58 years, and I have farmed this land all my life like my father did. This small rice plot is only a quarter hectare, so one full bag of DAP is too much for it, but I will try to get a small share — maybe half a bag — through the cooperative if it comes in time, because rice without some fertilizer gives very little. I keep my own seed from last year's harvest like always, I do not buy new seed from the shop. I have my two oxen and my sons help me with the ploughing and weeding, and the water comes from the rains and the low wet ground where this rice grows, I do not have a pump.
